has-subtle-color has-text-color"><span class="has-inline-color has-white-color">Accommodation</span></h1></div></div><div class="wp-block-group alignfull"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow"><h2 class="wp-block-heading">Looking for somewhere to stay on Fuerteventura?</h2><p class="wp-block-paragraph">Whether you want to live it up at one of our hotels or prefer to mix with other watersport enthusiasts at our hostel or apartments, we’ve got you covered. Book your accommodation on the island with us and be sure that you’ll be close to the beach.</p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">Here are our places to stay:</p><div class="wp-block-group alignfull is-style-default"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow"><div class="wp-block-columns alignwide tw-justify-center tw-gutter-large class="wp-block-heading tw-mb-2 has-large-font-size">Sol y Mar</h3><p class="has-small-font-size wp-block-paragraph"><strong>4km to Flag Beach</strong></p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">The Flag Beach surf hostel Sol y Mar is the original hostel regarded as the best value surf hostel in Fuerteventura, a great place for single travelers or groups of surfers.</p><div class="wp-block-buttons
